selected_method_readings.authors: Joseph R. Steneman and Giuseppe Vinci
selected_method_readings.version: Statistics and Computing36:226, version of record3 October2026
selected_method_readings.license: Article CC BY4.0; official repository MIT, complete license patch read.
selected_method_readings.actual_reading: Selected section3.1 assumptions,3.2 regression/regularization algorithm,3.3 theorem statement and observed-pair moment requirements (not proof audit),3.4 cross-validation,3.5 bootstrap, section6 and rights/code metadata. selected_method_readings.overlap_and_limit: Already completes structurally unobserved covariances using auxiliary relationships and quantifies estimator uncertainty. Extra auxiliary assumptions are essential; incomplete observed marginals cannot by themselves identify every missing relationship. The selected method is static estimation; authors list Bayesian extension as future work.
